checkpoint_build.qualification: Local Lean 4.33.0 environment with previously disclosed local Verso compatibility edits; not clean CI or publication acceptance.

evidence_policy.historical_packets: Preserve frozen bytes and historical status; pushing is not acceptance.
evidence_policy.experimental_proofs: Focused compilation and scoped reviews are recorded in individual packets; they are not whole-chain scientific root closure.
evidence_policy.resource_claim: Exact-real primitive bound is not a finite-bit classical or executable family certificate.
evidence_policy.curriculum: Bounded first slices only; not complete textbook formalization.
evidence_policy.publication: Four bounded records do not cover all changed modules. Main integration and reader gates remain open.

open_obligations: Finite-bit ideal-source approximation and classical runtime/cost accounting
Same-return saved circuit refinement, full terminal bond garbage, and independent family executable acceptance
Complete changed-module source-blind review and publication integration gates
excluded: User-owned uncommitted images and Robin executable/replay artifacts
Live cycle13 radius-supplier, finite-trig, and saved-action workspaces
Ignored local caches, raw runs, and credentials
remote_delivery: Verify the exact pushed commit separately; this file alone is not proof of delivery.
rollback: Revert this checkpoint commit on the contribution branch; do not rewrite historical evidence or user-owned changes.
